One broken crown ridge on the left; two remnants of thick frayed rope on shell to indicate scale. Real chipped stone, salt, wet dark teal joints, patinated copper construction, just tiny magenta rivulet behind gates. Large simple silhouette and distinct from family elites, no humanoid face. Main design profile is toward screen right, weight forward. Keep intact gate hinge and 2 shutters in every pose of this sheet. Image 1 defines family palette and textures only, image 2 is existing boss rendering style only. EXACT THREE ROWS by SIX COLUMNS.
